titleStmt.title: Kephalaia of the Teacher, edition page 68: diplomatic and Leiden transcription

sourceDesc.bibl: Kephalaia (Manichäische Handschriften der Staatlichen Museen Berlin), ed. H. J. Polotsky and A. Böhlig, Stuttgart: Kohlhammer, 68. Restorations, sublinear dots, gap counts and corrections are the editors'.

encodingDesc.p: EpiDoc. Read by eye from the page image; gap counts, sublinear dots and supralinear stroke extents verified by measurement on the image. A supralinear stroke is marked on every letter it covers by at least half its width. Spaces are the edition's word division. Facsimile zones are measured line centres. The editors' German statements are not transcribed: each is mapped to an id of the controlled vocabulary data/kephalaia/editorial_vocabulary.json and carried as @ana (ed: statements in the text, app: apparatus footnotes, tr: categories of the transcriber's commentary).

div.p: The framed manuscript page number [ⲝⲏ] (top left, even page) is restored in brackets as a whole; the bars above and below are the frame (no strokes). The running title [ⲛⲕⲉⲫⲁⲗⲁⲓⲟⲛ] is restored in brackets, with a stroke over its ⲛ (845–857). Every dot run was counted from the `dots` x-positions between the bracket positions.

Reconcile flags explained by position: dots of area < 6 on ll. 1 (759, in pieces), 2 (1134 in pieces; the pale ⲡ dot 1314), 3 (618), 12 (590, 644); dots at the zone centre on ll. 18 (563) and 32 (all twelve); l. 29 counts the detached end of the ⲙ stroke of ⲙ[ⲡⲉ] (1056/1488, 8×) as a dot.
A closing bracket after six dots (704–710) with no opener on the line and none at the end of p. 067 → ‡; the dots before it are illegible.
Six illegible dots (565–697), four (732–812; the third breaks into pieces at 759–761); dot under ⲥ of ⲛϩⲏ[ⲧ]ⲥ (1021); thirteen illegible dots (1050–1367).

Under ⲡ of ⲁⲩⲱⲡ a pale dot at the dot-row height (1313–1314, rows 379–382; area 1 at grey < 130, 6 at < 170, 13 at < 200, against 16/22 for the ⲱ dot): encoded as a dot (§3.20); it is the least certain mark on the page.
